member.name: T:Supabase.Functions.FunctionsInstrumentation
member.summary:
Diagnostics for the Functions client, exposed through so consumers can subscribe with the OpenTelemetry SDK using (AddSource(...) / AddMeter(...)). Emission is zero-cost when nothing is listening.
Telemetry must never carry secrets or PII: URLs are recorded without their query string and no tag may contain the request body, a token, or other sensitive value. The invoked function name is recorded (it is part of the path), but never the payload.
